name: I.C.C. International Public Company Limited
summary: I.C.C. International Public Company Limited engages in the distribution of consumer products in Thailand. The company operates through four segments: Cosmetics Toiletries & Perfumeries; Women's Apparel; Men's Apparel; and Household Products. It offers fashion and apparels, cosmetics, bags and leatherwear, shoes, sports products, heath and supplement products, household goods, and food and beverage products, as well as products for toddlers.
